title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to shape how people stay connected across calls, text, and email? Alexa Connections is building a trusted communication agent that understands intent, context, and relationships, then acts on a customer's behalf to make every interaction feel natural. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you'll design and deliver the software systems behind a context-aware assistant that grows more helpful over time. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding customer problems, through system design and implementation, to deployment and operations — building privacy-first solutions that serve tens of millions of daily communication events.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software services that model each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy-first representation of relationships and communication patterns used to power context-aware assistance.
* Build and operate scalable backend systems that integrate large language models and agentic reasoning to anticipate who, when, and how a customer wants to connect across calls, text, and email.
* Collaborate with scientists, product managers, and peer engineering teams to translate research advances in personalization and memory into reliable, production-grade features.
* Contribute to the full software development lifecycle — scoping, design, code review, testing, deployment, and operational support — while coaching teammates through constructive code reviews and documentation.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, and continuously improve system reliability, maintainability, and performance.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a design review for a new personalization feature, working through tradeoffs in scalability and data privacy with senior engineers and applied scientists. After lunch you could be writing and testing code for a service that ranks a customer's most relevant contacts, then pairing with a teammate on a code review. You'll regularly join standups with product managers and scientists to align on priorities, and you'll rotate through on-call responsibilities to keep the systems you build running smoothly.  
  
About the team  
The Alexa Connections team is growing, so you'll join early and help shape its engineering culture from the ground up. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and scientists who are invested in your growth, with mentorship and the chance to own meaningful problems. Our mission is to make communication effortless and trustworthy for customers worldwide, and we're focused on building intelligent, privacy-first systems that redefine how people stay in touch.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **ROLE SUMMARY**

Digital impacts everything we do. Pfizer’s end-to-end supply chain digital strategy is focused on delivering leading-edge decision support and visibility solutions to enable improved planning and risk management. The Digital Supply & Business Development Team is looking for a Senior Manager, Digital Product Owner to own the vision, roadmap and agile delivery of digital solutions to achieve our strategic goals and business objectives.

The Senior Manager, Digital Product Owner will drive the digital vision, road mapping, and delivery of launch solutions for >300 users world-wide. This includes a growing portfolio of AI-enabled products, such as AI agents, chatbots and predictive monitoring, built on trusted enterprise data. This role will partner with business leaders to envision the product/solution’s business strategy, ensure that the product roadmap delivers the agreed vision and metrics and is aligned with the overall enterprise strategy, and manage the product lifecycle following an agile methodology. The role leads a team of product owners and product analysts together with contract delivery resources and is accountable for their performance and delivery.

As an innovation thought partner to Digital and business colleagues, this role will be counted on to identify opportunities to use established and emerging digital capabilities, including generative and agentic AI, to unlock value through converging supply chain knowledge with future technologies.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the product vision, multi year roadmap, and success metrics, for the applications being delivered
* Own the AI roadmap for the launch portfolio: identify, prioritize and deliver AI use cases (agents, chatbots, monitoring and forecasting), and ensure agents are designed to work together rather than overlap
* Work with cross-functional teams of engineers and designers to deliver user-centric products
* Set priorities and make day-to-day trade-off decisions with the product owners, resolving competing demands across the launch portfolio
* Exercise a strong decision-making mandate across cross-functional teams as the accountable decision-maker for the launch product portfolio
* Lead the agile practice for the digital product portfolio, including directing scrum masters, business analysts, systems analysts, and AI engineers to drive continuous improvement in delivery predictability, quality and throughput, and promote practical use of AI tools (e.g., Copilot, AI prototyping tools) in backlog, design and documentation work
* Direct the full product lifecycle from opportunity definition through design, release and adoption, ensuring solutions meet user needs and realize the committed business value
* Partner with data owners and enterprise data teams to ensure data ownership, definitions and master data governance are in place before AI capabilities are introduced
* Define and track AI value metrics (e.g., adoption, planning time saved, manual effort reduced) and report outcomes to senior leadership
* Manage AI vendors, partners and contract resources, including build-vs-buy decisions, resource estimates and budget planning
* Ensure launch solutions, including AI-enabled solutions, are delivered and sustained in compliance with Pfizer quality, data-integrity and GxP validation requirements (where applicable) and responsible-AI governance standards, partnering with Compliance & Risk Management and Enterprise Architecture
* Serve as innovation thought partner to PGS and Digital leadership — identifying where emerging digital capabilities can unlock supply chain value, and building the business case through demos, prototypes and presentations to senior leadership to secure endorsement and funding

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related field required
* 8+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years leading teams or managing people, with pharmaceutical or healthcare experience a strong plus
* Experience delivering AI-enabled products (e.g., generative AI, chatbots, agents) from use-case definition through production
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts, including agent orchestration, integration with enterprise data and tools, and evaluating AI output quality
* Fluency with enterprise AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, AI prototyping tools) and ability to coach teams in using them
* Experience successfully creating and executing against product visions, strategies, and roadmaps that achieve goals and outcomes
* Exceptional at working with and analyzing user metrics and turning them into actionable insights
* A curious and highly motivated self-starter who can work effectively across cross-functional teams and can independently drive progress toward completion with proper planning and management
* Passion for creating user-centric digital and interactive experiences
* Agile/Lean Development knowledge, training or experience.
* A strong communicator with great written and verbal skills
* Up to date and knowledgeable about the latest trends, innovations and best practices in the digital space, including AI

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* MBA or Master’s degree in strategy, management, or related field is a plus
* Certification in Agile and Scrum development practices is a plus
* Experience in product design and data & analytics, including data governance and data products that feed AI solutions
* Experience managing external AI/technology vendors and working in a federated product or platform model
* ERP systems knowledge e.g. SAP (S4 HANA, IBP, MDG)

description:

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar products generate and process large volumes of real-time data from sensors, onboard models, and control systems, enabling advanced operational insights across mining environments. As part of Caterpillar’s digital strategy, the MineStar suite delivers an integrated platform that connects machines and enterprise systems to enable real-time monitoring, control, and optimisation of mining operations.

To support this vision, we are evolving our software delivery model through a **DevSecOps approach**, embedding security, automation, and operational excellence across the software lifecycle.

We are seeking an experienced **Product Owner – DevSecOps** to lead prioritisation and delivery within a DevSecOps enablement team. This role focuses on enabling engineering teams to deliver software **faster, more securely, and with greater reliability** through platform capabilities, standardised pipelines, and integrated security practices.

**Role Overview**

The Product Owner – DevSecOps is responsible for defining and prioritising the backlog for DevSecOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, security controls, and developer enablement services.

The role acts as the bridge between **engineering, security, platform, and business stakeholders**, ensuring that DevSecOps investments deliver measurable improvements in delivery velocity, quality, security, and compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **DevSecOps Backlog Ownership**
  + Own and prioritise the DevSecOps backlog, aligning with platform strategy, security requirements, and engineering needs.
  + Define and sequence features such as CI/CD pipelines, IaC capabilities, environment provisioning, and security tooling.

* **Program Increment (PI) Planning & Delivery**
  + Lead backlog refinement and planning activities for Program Increments, ensuring clear, prioritised, and outcome-driven deliverables.
  + Ensure features deliver measurable improvements in automation, standardisation, and developer experience.

* **Security & Compliance Integration**
  + Drive the inclusion of security controls (e.g., scanning, secrets management, policy-as-code) into delivery pipelines.
  + Ensure alignment with enterprise compliance frameworks and audit requirements (e.g., ISO, governance standards).

* **Platform & Enablement Focus**
  + Prioritise initiatives that enable self-service, reusable “golden paths,” and standardised DevSecOps patterns across teams.
  + Balance platform standardisation with product team flexibility and adoption.

* **Technical Alignment & Architecture Enablement**
  + Collaborate with architects and technical leads to support architectural runway, including infrastructure modernisation, pipeline standardisation, and reduction of technical debt.
  + Ensure adequate backlog allocation for platform capabilities and engineering enablement.

* **Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**
  + Act as the primary interface between DevSecOps teams and stakeholders across engineering, security, and leadership.
  + Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes.

* **Value Delivery & Continuous Improvement**
  + Define success metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time, security posture, incident reduction).
  + Continuously refine priorities based on feedback, adoption, and performance data.

**Experience Required**

* 4+ years’ experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in software delivery environments.
* Experience working with **DevOps or DevSecOps practices**, including CI/CD, cloud platforms, or infrastructure automation.
* Proven experience working within Agile frameworks (SAFe, Scrum, etc.).
* Experience delivering platform or enablement capabilities (preferred).

**Skills Required**

* Strong understanding of **DevSecOps principles**, including automation, security integration, and continuous delivery.
* Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into **business value outcomes**.
* Strong stakeholder management across engineering, security, and leadership domains.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to prioritise high-impact initiatives.
* Strong communication and influencing skills in complex, cross-functional environments.
* Familiarity with modern engineering ecosystems (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub, cloud platforms, IaC tools).
